# WO-196: Create original website refresh artwork
Status: delivered; owner review requested (issue #179)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-designer
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Amara Okoye
Source: WO-194 / `docs/vendor/CODEX_SITE_REFRESH.md`

## Goal
Create a small set of original, lightweight conceptual illustrations that explain ideas about the product without depicting or standing in for the product itself.

## Acceptance criteria
- Add up to three original SVGs for the idea that information stays on a user's PC, the removal-request loop, and helping a parent.
- Conceptual illustrations never stand in for product screenshots or pictures. WO-200 uses a real product screenshot in the home hero.
- Keep files self-contained, accessible when informative, and decorative only when paired with an empty alt value at use.
- Use no external references, embedded raster data, personal data, identifiable people, third-party logos, or unsourced claims.
- Any visible sample data must be labelled “Example with made-up data”.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/art/site-refresh/` (new files only)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No page/component integration, existing artwork, brand logo, app files, tests, dependencies, or external assets.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- Inspect SVG source for external references and accessibility metadata; report dimensions and file sizes.

## Check-in plan
Owner tooling prepares `.vendor-wt/wo-196`. Page refresh WOs may use these assets after owner review.

## Notes and decisions
Design from Free My ID's identity and audience needs; do not reproduce reference-site illustrations or visual assets.
